mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone increases bone mineral density while alendronate also works to increase BMD through different mechanisms (progesterone via bone formation, bisphosphonate via bone resorption inhibition), creating potential for excessive bone density changes and altered pharmacodynamics.
action: Monitor bone mineral density response and consider coordinating therapy timing; separate dosing by at least 30 minutes and maintain alendronate administration guidelines (upright position, empty stomach) as medroxyprogesterone does not significantly alter alendronate absorption.
